title: 106th Rescue Wing August Team Rescue TV
description: The 106th Rescue Wing produces its monthly news broadcast Team Rescue TV at Francis S. Gabreski Air National Guard Base, Westhampton Beach, N.Y., August 3, 2024. Team Rescue TV is the 106th's monthly news broadcast that informs the Wing on events and training conducted throughout each month. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Captain Cheran Campbell, Technical Sgt. Daniel Farrell, Technical Sgt. Sean Madden, Technical Sgt. Kevin Donaldson, and Senior Airman Sarah McKernan)
keywords: 106th Rescue Wing, NYNG, Air National Guard
credit: Capt. Cheran Campbell, Tech. Sgt. Kevin Donaldson, Tech. Sgt. Daniel Farrell, Tech. Sgt. Sean Madden, Senior Airman Sarah McKernan

transcript.text: Welcome to TRTV . You can watch this
broadcast on YouTube or Facebook at any
time .
On June 9th , the family readiness
group held a member appreciation
breakfast . Thank you to all those who
attended and a very special thank you
to family readiness for putting on such
a wonderful event . Doing our level 3
mentorship ride today , there's a
chance for our military members that
ride motorcycles off duty to
participate in a ride on regular roads ,
get some training through them
practicing their safety , safe skills
their . Road riding skills . We do it
in a group session , a group manner and
it's a good opportunity for us to
practice our safe riding skills as a
group . And , uh , it's , it's a good
mentoring opportunity as those that are
experienced riders also share their
knowledge and skills with those who are
more Davis riders . On June 7th ,
Lieutenant Colonel Kyle Haws was
appointed to take command of the 102
Rescue Squadron . Haroz began his
career with the 106 Rescue wing in 2006
and has served a variety of positions
to include aircraft commander ,
instructor pilot , and HC 130J
conversion officer . Brus replaces
Colonel Sean Gorrell , who assumes the
role of deputy commander of the 106
Operations Group . Congratulations ,
gentlemen . The 106 rescue wing's first
HH 60 whiskey Jolly Green 2 search and
rescue helicopter touched down at
Greski Air National Guard Base on
Thursday , June 20th . The arrival of
the new helicopter marks the beginning
of a new era as the 106 transitions
from the HH60G Pahock to the latest
model . From June 21st to the
24th , the 102 rescue squadron joined
the US Embassy Air Attache on an
inaugural visit to Faroe Island , an
autonomous territory of Denmark . The
goal was to engage the Faroese
government , Danish military and
civilian-led rescue teams in an effort
to learn their rescue capabilities and
area of responsibility . It was also an
opportunity for the 102 to familiarize
themselves with the airfield , local
terrain , and weather . The 106 rescue
wing hopes to build on this
relationship with future training
opportunities . From July 16th to the
19th . The 106 rescue wing held a
summer training program for junior
reserve Officer Training Corps cadets
from various Suffolk County high
schools . The JROTC program's agenda
was comprehensive , covering mission
development and planning , combat
medicine , aircraft maintenance ,
weapons familiarization , survival and
land navigation , and concluded with a
challenging search and rescue mission .
This year's 106 rescue wing Galaxy camp
saw 60 military children dive into STEM
activities and exciting visits . Thanks
to our community partners for donating
their time and resources , and a big
shout out to Mr . and Mrs . Dacasino ,
all campers , junior counselors , and
service members for a successful camp .
Do you want valuable knowledge to bring
back to your unit ? Ever wonder what
happens in finance ? Finance is looking
for to hire a temporary technician
position . Based on your experience ,
you could be a GS 7 or 9 or 11 .
Contact senior master Sergeant Alvarado
for any more information . The
Comptroller flight has a Power BI page
where you can view finance reports ,
overdue arrows , unsubmitted DTS
vouchers , as well as open leave in
need of closing . You can find links to
popular pages like SharePoint , DTS ,
Arrows , and CSP . There has been
a change in travel miles . Travel
greater than 250 miles one way will
require constructed travel worksheet
and DTS . Training slides and
worksheets can be found on how-to
guides and forms . You can also
reference a basewide email sent June
4th by Master Sergeant Alvarado .
The window is now open to submit your
recruitment incentive and retention
program requests for the fall semester .
You must take between 6 and 12 credits
to be eligible for the tuition
assistance , be a New York State
resident , attend a New York State
school , and have an ETS state that
extends beyond the semester end date .
Lastly , once you apply for a certain
number of credits , you must maintain
the same amount of credits for that
semester . The deadline is a firm
August 15th , no exceptions . September
7th is Family day . Enjoy a day of fun ,
food , games , and camaraderie . Spouse
flights are also available . However ,
you will have to register by August
16th and have medical forms in by
August 30th . Trunko Tree kicks off
this year , October 26th from 2 to 4
p.m. Service members and children can
enjoy a Halloween parade , pumpkin
picking and decorating , sweet treats
and group photos in our spookatorium .
Registration closes October 8th . For
more details on the events featured in
this broadcast , please check the
e-board . The 106 Public Affairs office
is looking for help . If you are a
staff sergeant or below and have an
interest in photo , video , and social
media engagement , you may be the right
fit for our PA team . For more
information , please contact Captain
Campbell via email or by calling
extension 7470 .
